name: poison spray
lore:
# On the Noxious Exhalation: Poison Spray

To invoke *Poison Spray* is to invite a momentary rot into the palm. As the somatic components are traced, the Weave feels curdled—a sour, viscous tension that pricks the skin like invisible nettles. Upon release, a puff of bilious, viridian vapor erupts, smelling of swamp-rot and spent sulfur. It is not a projectile, but a heavy, choking miasma that clings to the lungs of the unwary.

Scholars attribute its codification to the recluse **Morwenna of the Black Mire**. Seeking to replicate the defensive spores of the Cinder-Fungus, she spent decades distilling the essence of decay into a linguistic trigger. It is said she first unleashed the spell when cornered by brigands; with a single, sharp exhalation of magic, she turned the very air into a tomb, leaving her foes to gasp as their lifeblood curdled into bile.

Adventurers take heed: though its range is modest, the spray ignores the sturdiest plate, for no armor can bar a breath of death.
